front.title: Using RPC-with-TLS with DNS-Based Authentication of Named Entities

abstract.t: RPC-with-TLS assumes that DNS-Based Authentication of Named Entities (DANE) is available on platforms where it is deployed, and recommends that a client operating under an opportunistic security policy check for a TLSA record before initiating an association, but does not say how. This document specifies the missing details, so that a TLSA record authenticates an RPC server with no certification authority trust anchor provisioned on the client. It updates RFC 9289.
